rows.grounds: third-person singular active present of pat, 'to fall'
fused form jitaḥ (participle) + asmi (first-person singular present of as); transcribed with internal + retained
instrumental singular of the second-person pronoun

items.question: What bodily sign and verbal declaration mark the moment of surrender to the possessing deity?
premises: The possessed person falls at the deity's feet.
He declares himself conquered by the deity.
items.inference: The verse identifies prostration and verbal submission as the culminating sign of divine possession.
uncertainties: The exact addressee and ritual context are not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Or he quickly falls at your feet, saying, 'I am conquered by you.'
